_meta.description: Combat glossary from the eog.gg 'Terms' database tab: core stats, combat mechanics and status effects with their in-game definitions, plus the stat-sheet list (33 stats with unit and an example endgame value).

records.name: Attack
records.definition: The higher your Attack, the more damage you deal to enemies.

records.name: Defense
records.definition: The higher your Defense, the less damage you take.

records.name: HP
records.definition: When HP reaches 0 the unit is downed and can no longer act.

records.name: Speed
records.definition: The higher your Speed, the shorter the interval between your actions.

records.name: Crit Rate
records.definition: Chance to amplify the damage a hit deals.

records.name: Crit DMG
records.definition: When a Crit triggers, this is how much it amplifies the damage dealt.

records.name: Crit RES
records.definition: Higher Crit RES lowers the chance enemies Crit you, and reduces the damage their Crits deal.

records.name: Block Rate
records.definition: Chance to reduce part of the damage taken. A Block cannot also Crit.

records.name: Block DMG RES
records.definition: When a Block triggers, this is how much it reduces the damage taken.

records.name: Precision
records.definition: Higher Precision lowers enemies' chance to Block against you, and weakens the damage their Blocks would reduce.

records.name: DMG Bonus
records.definition: Amplifies the damage you deal to enemies.

records.name: DMG RES
records.definition: Reduces the damage you take.

records.name: Healing Bonus
records.definition: Increases the potency of the healing you provide.

records.name: DMG to Characters
records.definition: Increases the damage you deal to player Characters.

records.name: Character DMG RES
records.definition: Reduces the damage you take from Characters.

records.name: DMG to Monsters
records.definition: Increases the damage you deal to monsters.

records.name: Monster DMG RES
records.definition: Reduces the damage you take from monsters.

records.name: Effect Hit
records.definition: Higher Effect Hit raises the chance to apply Ailments and Debuffs to enemies.

records.name: Effect RES
records.definition: Higher Effect RES lowers the chance enemies apply Ailments and Debuffs to you.

records.name: Elemental Mastery
records.definition: Increases the elemental damage you deal.

records.name: Elemental RES
records.definition: Reduces the elemental damage you take.

records.name: Physical Mastery
records.definition: Increases the Physical damage you deal.

records.name: Physical RES
records.definition: Reduces the Physical damage you take.

records.name: Wind Affinity
records.definition: Increases the damage dealt by your Wind skills.

records.name: Water Affinity
records.definition: Increases the damage dealt by your Water skills.

records.name: Fire Affinity
records.definition: Increases the damage dealt by your Fire skills.

records.name: Light Affinity
records.definition: Increases the damage dealt by your Light skills.

records.name: Dark Affinity
records.definition: Increases the damage dealt by your Dark skills.

records.name: Wind Aegis
records.definition: Reduces the Wind damage you take.

records.name: Water Aegis
records.definition: Reduces the Water damage you take.

records.name: Fire Aegis
records.definition: Reduces the Fire damage you take.

records.name: Light Aegis
records.definition: Reduces the Light damage you take.

records.name: Dark Aegis
records.definition: Reduces the Dark damage you take.

records.name: At the Start of Battle
records.definition: When a unit has multiple pre-battle skills to cast, they activate in order: Charms before Techniques, top to bottom by slot. If multiple units have pre-battle skills, they act from highest to lowest SPD. The formal first turn begins after both sides finish casting these skills.

records.name: Zero Initial CD
records.definition: This skill can be cast on the caster's first turn and enters cooldown after casting.

records.name: Movement
records.definition: Units can usually move up to 4 grids per turn. Movement granted by skills is separate and does not count toward this limit.

records.name: Approach
records.definition: After being knocked back, if Movement is above 0, the unit approaches its target to unleash a Technique. Before the turn ends, if a Technique is ready but out of range, remaining Movement is spent to approach the nearest target.

records.name: Action Advance
records.definition: Advances the bearer's action bar, accelerating their next turn.

records.name: Action Delay
records.definition: Delays the target's action. A target can be delayed by up to 80% per turn.

records.name: Displacement
records.definition: Any forced repositioning of a unit, including Pull, Knockback and Airborne. Large targets resist most displacement.

records.name: Pull
records.definition: Forcibly drags the target toward a destination grid.

records.name: Knockback
records.definition: Knocks the target back a set distance. On collision with a unit or obstacle, the collided enemy takes Physical DMG once equal to 10% of its max HP, capped at 60% of the caster's ATK.

records.name: Summon
records.definition: A summon's level equals the casting skill's level. Summons inherit a portion of the caster's stats and act on their own, but cannot receive any stat boosts.

records.name: Doom DMG
records.definition: Shield Break: deals +100% DMG to an enemy target's shields, and +100% DMG to enemy summons.

records.name: Base Chance
records.definition: The base chance of inflicting a status on the target. The final chance is shifted by the attacker's Effect Hit and the target's Effect RES.

records.name: Lifesteal
records.definition: Heals the caster for a percentage of the DMG dealt to the target. DMG dealt to shields does not trigger it.

records.name: Heal
records.definition: Healing Techniques only heal targets below 100% HP. Healing power is based on the caster's max HP.

records.name: Shield
records.definition: Absorbs DMG, depleted before HP. With multiple shields: those with a turn limit deplete first, then those without; shields of the same type deplete in the order applied.

records.name: Max HP Boost
records.definition: The bearer keeps the same HP percentage when an effect that boosts max HP is applied or removed.

records.name: Revive
records.definition: Returns a downed ally to battle with a portion of their HP restored.

records.name: Disperse
records.definition: Removes active status effects from a target.

records.name: Counterstrike
records.definition: A retaliatory strike that triggers when its condition is met, typically after the bearer takes Technique DMG.

records.name: Adventurer
records.definition: The main character only. Companions, summons and materialized Fantomons are not included.

records.name: Character
records.definition: The main character and companions only. Summons and materialized Fantomons are not included.

records.name: Non-Character Units
records.definition: Monsters, Summons and materialized Fantomons.

records.name: Ailment
records.definition: Severe status effects: Frozen, Stun, Immobilize, Frenzy and Action Delay. After an Ailment lands, the chance of inflicting one again next turn is halved and keeps dropping with each consecutive infliction.

records.name: Debuff
records.definition: Negative effects: stat reductions (e.g. ATK Reduction), damage over time (e.g. Erosion), increased DMG taken (e.g. Shattering Sigil), Blind, Taunt and more.

records.name: Frozen
records.definition: Prevents movement and skill use, and disables Charms or statuses that require casting. Cannot be re-frozen while frozen. Base Resilience Break: 50.

records.name: Stun
records.definition: Prevents CD reduction, movement and skill use on the affected unit's turn, and blocks Charms or statuses that require casting. Base Resilience Break: 50.

records.name: Immobilize
records.definition: The unit cannot move. Base Resilience Break: 30.

records.name: Frenzy
records.definition: Frenzied units treat everyone but themselves as enemies and randomly target within range. Summoning Techniques still work; self-buff, heal and shield Techniques are disabled. Base Resilience Break: 60.

records.name: Taunt
records.definition: Taunted enemies target the caster only and approach to use damaging Techniques. Summoning Techniques still work; ally-targeting Techniques are disabled.

records.name: Blind
records.definition: Grants a 50% chance to miss the target with the next damaging Technique.

records.name: Wet
records.definition: Increases the chance of being Frozen by 30%.

records.name: Cold
records.definition: Increases Water DMG taken by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times.

records.name: Electro
records.definition: When an Electro target takes Light DMG from a Technique, the Electro is removed to deal additional Light DMG once and chain it to 1 random enemy within 2 grids.

records.name: Burn
records.definition: Burns a grid for 3 turns, dealing Fire DMG to enemies on it: when newly applied, when an enemy moves onto it, and at the start of a turn spent on it. Repeat Burn DMG from the same skill in one turn drops 35% each time, up to 3 times. Cannot be applied to water.

records.name: Fear
records.definition: The afflicted unit will not prioritize the inflictor as an attack target.

records.name: Airborne
records.definition: Airborne targets cannot counterattack; Blocking removes it. Large targets cannot be knocked Airborne. It is brief: if left unharmed, the target soon falls and returns to normal.

records.name: Erosion
records.definition: At the start of each turn, triggers once to deal Dark DMG. Lasts 3 turns; re-applying it with the same skill from the same caster extends the duration.

records.name: Lifeforce (Blood Source)
records.definition: When a target with Blood Source takes Technique DMG, 3% of the DMG dealt is converted to the attacker's HP, up to 50% of max HP. DMG to shields does not trigger it.
